zh.title: 義大利埃特納火山灰致卡塔尼亞機場停飛並導致多班機改降
zh.summary: 埃特納火山灰致卡塔尼亞機場停飛；至少10班機改降巴勒莫、特拉帕尼、科米索
body: 義大利埃特納火山於9月26日噴發，火山灰柱高達約4公里，向南飄移，導致卡塔尼亞豐塔納羅薩機場（CTA）在當地時間9月27日中午12時前全面暫停起降。
機場營運商SAC於9月26日宣佈關閉C1、B3空域，至少10班次被迫改降，分別飛往巴勒莫（PMO）5班、特拉帕尼（TPS）3班、科米索（CIY）2班；達美航空紐約至卡塔尼亞航班改降羅馬菲烏米奇諾（FCO）。
馬耳他航空取消KM642與KM643往返班次，布魯塞爾航空取消卡塔尼亞至布魯塞爾航班並將另一班次改降巴勒莫改乘大巴；比利時TUI飛行亦改經巴勒莫。

en.title: Etna ash forces Catania Airport to suspend flights, diverts at least 10 services
en.summary: Etna ash shuts Catania airport; at least 10 flights diverted to Palermo, Trapani, Comiso
body: Mount Etna erupted on 26 September, sending an ash column about 4 kilometres high toward the south, which forced Catania Fontanarossa Airport (CTA) to suspend all arrivals and departures until 12:00 local time on 27 September.

Airport operator SAC closed airspace sectors C1 and B3; at least ten flights were diverted – five to Palermo (PMO), three to Trapani (TPS) and two to Comiso (CIY) – and a Delta Air Lines New York‑Catania service was rerouted to Rome Fiumicino (FCO).

KM Malta Airlines cancelled flights KM642 and KM643, Brussels Airlines cancelled its Catania‑Brussels flight and diverted another to Palermo with passengers continuing by bus, while TUI fly Belgium also rerouted via Palermo.

facts.claim: SAC announced on 26 September that all flight operations at Catania Fontanarossa would be suspended until 12:00 local time on 27 September because of volcanic ash and prevailing wind conditions.
facts.sourceQuote: SAC , said on September 26 that all flight operations at Catania Fontanarossa would be suspended until 12:00 local time on September 27 because of volcanic ash and prevailing wind conditions.

facts.claim: At least ten flights were diverted, with five sent to Palermo (PMO), three to Trapani (TPS) and two to Comiso (CIY).
facts.sourceQuote: At least 10 flights were diverted, according to Italian media reports. Five were sent to Palermo (PMO), three to Trapani (TPS) and two to Comiso (CIY).

facts.claim: A Delta Air Lines flight from New York to Catania was diverted to Rome Fiumicino (FCO).
facts.sourceQuote: A Delta Air Lines flight from New York to Catania was also diverted to Rome Fiumicino (FCO).

facts.claim: KM Malta Airlines cancelled flights KM642 and KM643 on 26 September due to the volcanic activity and resulting restrictions at Catania.
facts.sourceQuote: KM Malta Airlines confirmed that it canceled KM642 from Malta to Catania and KM643 from Catania to Malta on September 26 because of the volcanic activity and resulting restrictions at Catania.

facts.claim: INGV reported an ash plume reaching approximately 4 kilometres above sea level, moving south, and a red VONA was issued.
facts.sourceQuote: The Italian National Institute of Geophysics and Volcanology (INGV) reported an ash plume reaching approximately 4 kilometers above sea level, with the cloud moving south. A red Volcano Observatory Notice for Aviation (VONA) was issued in response to the ongoing ash emission.
